commercial_services.text: id="main" class="site-main"> Commercial Services Running a business comes with plenty of challenges—your electrical system shouldn’t be one of them. We minimize downtime and ensure your systems are efficient and dependable. Reliable Electrical Solutions for Local Utah Businesses Whether you’re expanding your space, upgrading outdated wiring, or need a quick repair to keep things running, we’re here to make sure your electrical needs are handled safely, efficiently, and with minimal disruption to your operations. Our licensed and experienced electricians specialize in commercial electrical work, serving businesses of all sizes with dependable, code-compliant solutions. From retail storefronts to warehouses, office buildings to industrial sites, we keep your business powered and productive. Schedule Service Electrical Repairs Have you had a power outage in the building? Is something regularly tripping breakers? Are there flickering lights all over the office? We offer fast, reliable repair services to diagnose and fix electrical issues before they interrupt your business or become safety hazards. We respond quickly and work efficiently to get you back up and running. Installations Whether you’re adding a new wing or upgrading your existing setup, our team installs everything from outlets and lighting to large-scale commercial equipment. We ensure each component is installed to meet your unique needs and the latest safety standards. Electrical Remodels If your business is undergoing a remodel or renovation, our commercial electricians work closely with your general contractor to update or redesign your electrical layout. We’ll make sure everything from lighting placement to panel capacity is optimized for your space and operations. Lighting Let there be light, exactly where and how you need it. We handle all types of commercial lighting, including energy-efficient upgrades, LED retrofits, emergency lighting, motion sensors, and custom lighting designs for both interiors and exteriors. Whether you need new lighting solutions or you simply want to make sure you’re getting the best lighting options possible, we’re here to help. Electrical Inspections & Code Violation Correction Need to assess your system’s safety or prepare for a sale or expansion? Are you concerned about electrical code violations that easily become a headache? Our thorough electrical inspections identify potential hazards and inefficiencies before they turn into costly problems. We’ll give you a clear, actionable report to keep your system up to par. Avoid fines and ensure a safe environment for your team and customers with EZ Electric. Panels & Meters If your electrical panel is outdated or you’re adding more load to your system, we offer panel upgrades and new meter installations to ensure your system is equipped to handle your current and future needs. EV Chargers With more companies switching to electric vehicle fleets or offering EV charging as an employee perk, we understand that your business may need a little help. At EZ Electric, we install commercial-grade EV charging stations with scalable options for growth. Whether you need a single charging station or several, give us a call! New Construction If you’re building from the ground up, you’ll need an electrical contractor or licensed electrician to ensure that you have the power you need, both for now and for future growth. We provide complete electrical solutions for new commercial construction, working directly with your builder to ensure everything is installed efficiently, up to code, and ready for inspection. Smoke & Carbon Monoxide Detectors Safety first. We install and maintain smoke and CO detectors that comply with commercial safety regulations and keep your staff and property protected. Landscape Lighting & Electrical Create a welcoming and secure environment with custom landscape lighting and outdoor electrical systems. Whether it’s accent lighting for a storefront or power for signage, we’ll design and install your outdoor and landscape lighting to fit your needs. Generators Don’t let a power outage take your business offline. We install and service commercial backup generators to keep your essential systems up and running no matter what the weather, or the grid, is doing. Commercial Machine Power If you’re running heavy machinery or specialized commercial equipment, we’ll ensure you have the correct power supply and infrastructure to support your operations without overload or downtime. Tenant Improvement Need to customize a leased space for your business? Our tenant improvement services provide targeted electrical upgrades to meet the unique demands of your industry, on time and on budget. Keeping Your Business Powered Safely Why Choose Us? outdoor_specialty_electrical_services.text: id="main" class="site-main"> Outdoor & Specialty Electrical Services Power Your Outdoor Spaces and Specialty Projects with Confidence Whether you’re looking to create a relaxing backyard retreat, improve safety and visibility, or power up new features like a hot tub or EV charger, we provide expert electrical services to bring your vision to life. At EZ Electric, we help homeowners upgrade their outdoor and specialty electrical systems with professional installations, repairs, and customized solutions. Our licensed electricians have the experience and tools to light things up and power things down the right way. Schedule Service Outdoor Lighting The right outdoor lighting does more than boost curb appeal—it enhances safety, security, and functionality. We design and install landscape, pathway, security, and patio lighting to highlight features, improve visibility, and create inviting outdoor spaces. From concept to installation, we’ll help you choose lighting that fits your style, budget, and long-term goals. Outdoor Outlets & Power Need more power outside? Whether it’s for seasonal decorations, electric tools, or powering up your patio, we install outdoor-rated outlets and circuits that are weather-resistant and safely grounded. We also offer GFCI (Ground Fault Circuit Interrupter) outlets for added protection against electrical shock in damp or wet areas. Spa, Hot Tub & Pool Wiring Are you installing a new spa or pool? These features require specialized wiring and grounding to ensure safe operation. We handle everything from dedicated circuits to bonding and grounding systems, ensuring your setup meets local codes and manufacturer specifications. If you already have a spa or hot tub that’s giving you issues, we also provide troubleshooting and repairs to keep things running smoothly and safely. Generators Don’t get left in the dark when the power goes out. We install and service backup generators to keep essential systems like refrigerators, lights, and medical devices running when the grid goes down. We’ll help you choose the right size and type of generator for your home, install it professionally, and make sure it's ready when you need it most. EV Charger Installation If you’ve made the switch to an electric vehicle, we make charging at home simple and efficient. We install all levels of EV chargers for faster charging and long-term convenience. Whether it’s in your garage, driveway, or a custom location, we’ll ensure the electrical system is prepared to handle the load safely and reliably. We also handle panel upgrades if your current electrical system doesn’t have the capacity to support an EV charger. Panel & Meter Upgrades Your electrical panel is the heart of your home’s power system, and if you’re adding high-demand features like a pool, hot tub, or EV charger, your panel may need an upgrade. Our certified electricians assess your home’s current load and future needs. From there, we recommend and install panels and meters that provide the capacity and safety your system requires. A panel upgrade is a smart way to future-proof your home, reduce the risk of overloads, and ensure everything runs without a hitch. Keeping Your Outdoor Spaces Powered Safely Why Choose Us? residential_services.text: id="main" class="site-main"> Residential Services When it comes to your home’s electrical system, safety and reliability are non-negotiable. Our expert electricians are here to help keep your home powered up and running smoothly. Utah’s Residential Electrical Experts; Quality Work, Guaranteed. We offer a full range of residential electrical services, from repairs to new installations, and even full-home rewiring. Whether you’ve noticed the lights flickering, outlets that are hot to the touch, or you want to add something new and interesting to your lighting design or outdoor space, we handle it all. With efficiency, safety, and excellence in mind, our electricians bring the spark back to your space. Schedule Service Electrical Repairs & Installations Does your home have an outlet that’s not working or a breaker that keeps tripping? Have you noticed wires or outlets that are warmer than they should be? These can be signs of electrical problems within your home. Our skilled electricians diagnose and repair all kinds of electrical issues, ensuring your home stays safe and functional. If you need something new installed, we make sure it’s done right the first time. Whether it’s ceiling fans, new outlets, or high-tech home theater wiring, our licensed electricians are here to help. Electrical Remodels & Whole-Home Rewiring Remodeling your home can be a stressful process, but when it comes to the electrical system, you don’t have to worry. Are you adding a room or even finishing off the basement? Don’t forget about the electrical work that’s required, including new outlets, lighting, and even system upgrades. We’ll work with you to ensure that you have the power you need and that it’s safe and up to code. Do you need to rewire an older system? From smaller areas to whole-home rewiring, our residential electricians ensure that the wiring is up-to-date, efficient, and fully functional. We have the expertise to get the job done safely. Lighting & Landscape Electrical Brighten up your outdoor space with professional lighting installations. From energy-efficient LED upgrades to stunning landscape lighting that enhances your home’s curb appeal, our team has the expertise and experience you can rely on. If you’re considering new lighting inside the home, look no further than EZ Electric for your lighting needs. We can install under-cabinet lighting, recessed lighting, security lighting, and more. When considering the comfort of your home, the right lighting makes all the difference. Electrical Panels & Meters Your electrical panel is the heart of your home’s power system. If your home still has an outdated panel or you’re experiencing frequent power surges, it might be time for an upgrade. We install and replace electrical panels and meters to ensure your home has the power it needs for modern appliances and electronics. We’ll even work with the city to ensure that everything is up to code and follows all local ordinances. EV Chargers – Charge Up at Home Do you drive an electric vehicle, or are you considering getting one? Having the right power supply to keep you going is a crucial part of the equation. At EZ Electric, we install EV chargers to keep your car powered properly, giving you faster and more convenient charging right in your own garage. No more waiting in line at public charging stations; just plug in and power up from home! Hot Tubs, Pools & Spas Adding a little luxury to your backyard? We safely wire hot tubs, pools, and spas so you can enjoy your oasis worry-free. We’ll make sure your setup meets safety codes and is ready for relaxation. From hookups and panels to mood lighting and more, we help you enjoy your downtime in style. Generators – Stay Powered During Outages Don’t let a power outage leave you in the dark. A whole-home generator provides a reliable backup power source, keeping your essential appliances, lights, and HVAC system running when the grid goes down. Having a generator ensures your home stays comfortable and functional. We install and service a variety of emergency generators that automatically kick in when the power goes out, so you never have to worry about losing electricity. Smoke & Carbon Monoxide Detectors Safety first! Smoke and carbon monoxide detectors are essential for protecting your home and family from fire and deadly gas leaks. Our electricians make sure your detectors are properly wired, interconnected, and up to code. Whether you're upgrading to the latest technology or ensuring your existing system is fully functional, we’ll handle everything so you can rest easy knowing your home is safeguarded 24/7. website_accessibility.meta: EZ Electric is committed to furthering the accessibility and usability of its website, ezelectric.com.
website_accessibility.text: id="main" class="site-main"> Website Accessibility EZ Electric is committed to furthering the accessibility and usability of its website, ezelectric.com. EZ Electric will be using the relevant portions of the World Wide Web Consortium’s Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) to guide its compliance. The relevant portions of the WCAG will serve as our primary web accessibility standard, though other standards may also be used to provide accessibility to the extent required by the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). Please be aware that our efforts are ongoing. If you have specific questions or concerns about the accessibility of any particular webpage on ezelectric.com, please contact us at info@ezelectric.com or 385-220-7815. If you encounter an accessibility issue, please be sure to specify the particular web page in your email or phone call, and we will make all reasonable efforts to make that page accessible for you.
